rationale: The agent did not follow key policy steps. There is no clear authentication of the user beyond looking up by email. The agent performed a write (changing the default address) without first confirming with the user, violating the requirement to confirm before any order-changing action; moreover, they exposed the full Washington DC address even though the user said they didn’t want to reveal it. For the exchange request, although a modify_pending_order_items tool call appears in the log, the agent did not confirm details (which order/item, variant availability, payment method) before acting, nor provide a clear final confirmation or outcome of the exchange. The final response only mentions the address update and omits the exchange entirely. These issues mean the request was not completed in line with the policy.
